item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 25/Oct/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring mainly fine weather to southern China today and tomorrow. Under the influence of an upper-air disturbance, there will be showers and thunderstorms over the coastal areas of Guangdong during the weekend. Besides, a dry northeast monsoon will reach Guangdong early next week. The weather will improve gradually over the region. It will be slightly cooler in the morning and at night. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large.
